description.en:
Tells whether a tornado is currently active on the pitch.
It reads the active field of the tornado's entry in the pitch-object table: CMND_BTL_ACTIVE_TORNADE sets that field to 1 (or 3 for the stronger variant), and a freshly reserved tornado starts at 0.

true if the tornado is active, false if it is not.
null if the match system is not ready or no argument was given.

examples.case: A map helper that checks the first tornado (real usage, from mf11b01.nut)
Only placing a tornado that is not out yet
